svg.title: SkillLint security boundary
svg.desc: Allowed behavior includes reading UTF-8 documents, parsing limited metadata, checking local links and known text patterns, and writing local reports. Forbidden behavior includes executing instruction commands, calling agent tools, following remote links, or uploading scanned content.
svg.text: Static analysis, with a clear trust boundary
SkillLint is designed to inspect instructions as data—not to become the agent that runs them.
✓ Parse common frontmatter without YAML object construction
✓ Resolve local links and reject scope escapes
✓ Flag known risky commands and broad permissions
✓ Compare explicit modal phrases as a heuristic
✓ Write text, JSON, or SARIF to the local filesystem
× Execute shell commands or skill instructions
× Invoke external agent tools or plugins
× Crawl remote links or make network requests
× Upload scanned files or reports to a hosted service
× Guarantee all secrets or unsafe patterns are found
A CLEAN SCAN IS EVIDENCE FROM ENABLED RULES, NOT PROOF THAT A SKILL IS SAFE.
